summary: Spec written and measured at base 81df2b64 (worktree clean before and after every probe; .qa-s80/ gitignored so git status --short is empty). Behind ENABLE_URL_MODE_V2: a $0 syntactic pre-gate in url_routes AFTER the unchanged SSRF 400 and BEFORE _compare_urls_metered (nothing reserved, no search_logs row) refusing storefront roots / search / cart+checkout / account / category paths (price_service._NOT_A_PDP_HOME_PATH_RE :13019 and _NOT_A_PDP_SEARCH_PATH_RE :13027 reused, three narrow new path regexes) and url1 == url2 after normalisation, as HTTP 400 code NOT_PRODUCT_PAGE with additive field/reason carried through a flag-gated two-key passthrough in error_handler.http_exception_handler (measured: every other key of a structured detail is dropped at :133-138 and no detail in app/ carries field or reason today, so the passthrough is inert elsewhere). Post-fetch, a second fetch function _fetch_page_v2 keeps status and final url (fetch_page byte-unchanged): transport error / non-2xx (the measured V02 fragrancex 403) / title-anchored challenge page -> STORE_UNREADABLE; redirect ending on a root or search route -> NOT_PRODUCT_PAGE; no Product node (shape ladder: @graph, @type lists, ProductGroup.hasVariant) and no usable title, or LLM is_product_page false / null name -> UNRESOLVED_PRODUCT (the :527 'Unknown Product' default never reached ON; V09); a 25 s asyncio.wait_for around compare_from_urls -> code TIMEOUT via the shared text-route 503 mapping. Every new outcome is a non-delivery through the existing coded-failure exit (refund once, no lifetime RPC, no history row, W4-13 failure row with the code's constant message). Images: price_service._jsonld_image_urls + urljoin against the final url + https-only, og:image key-presence bug (:338-339) fixed; recommendation filled from strip_score_internals(winner_reason) with _QUALITATIVE_WINNER_REASON fallback and key_differences from specs_comparison advantages (the verdict schema at extraction_service.py:1032-1062 has neither key, which is why both are always empty today = V03). URL_EXTRACTION_PROMPT untouched (sha 411169d4...), URL_EXTRACTION_PROMPT_V2 derived by count-checked swaps and selected per call with the same kwargs; the four clear-lists gain the flag (R0-6); the W4-11 fixture is not regenerated; no metadata key on the URL envelope (R0-1); no route parameter (T23). Unflagged per R-A1(b): the INFO lines at url_routes.py:355 and :294 and url_extraction_service.py:474 print the host only. No Chrome impersonation (R-A7). Three bounded base runs green (111 / 9 / 61 passed). Comm candidate set 95 files hashed; 29 RED + 10 PIN rows; 47 mutants; 8 open questions.

open_questions: Q1 envelope keys: flag-gated two-key passthrough in error_handler.http_exception_handler (recommended; inert for every other route, measured) vs a JSONResponse(400) built in url_routes with its own request_id

Q2 reason vocabulary: R-A7 lists homepage|search|cart|category|same_url; the spec adds 'account' (the brief names account paths) and the post-fetch reasons fetch_error|blocked|redirect_cap|http_403|http_4xx|http_5xx|http_3xx|challenge|no_product_node|not_product_page|null_name; accept (recommended) or fold account into cart and drop post-fetch reasons
Q3 deadline: module constant 25.0 with a test seam (recommended) vs an env knob URL_COMPARE_DEADLINE_SECONDS with defensive parse
Q4 third INFO line: url_routes.py:294 (/extract POST, admin-only) also prints the full url and is included in the unflagged host-only change; confirm or restrict to the two lines the brief names
Q5 mixed-code precedence STORE_UNREADABLE > NOT_PRODUCT_PAGE > UNRESOLVED_PRODUCT with field both (recommended) vs the first url's code
Q6 ItemList pages: a page with any Product node is never UNRESOLVED even when the LLM says is_product_page false (recommended) vs letting false override a node-bearing page

Q7 W0-4 interaction: extract_generic_data_v2 runs through the same run_parse_offloaded under ENABLE_PRICE_PARSE_OFFLOAD (ON in production); R19 runs in both parse-flag states; confirm sufficient or require a W0-4f-style thread pin for the v2 extractor
